If even one of these appears, stop and verify through official channels before doing anything.
Deadlines in minutes or hours — 'account blocks today', 'offer expires now'. Real institutions give written notice and time.
'Don't tell your bank/family/unit.' Isolation is a control tactic; genuine officials never forbid you from consulting others.
No bank, army office, telecom company or portal ever needs your OTP, UPI PIN, CVV or password. This single sign settles it.
Any flow where you must scan a QR, enter a PIN, or pay a 'fee' to RECEIVE funds is inverted — receiving never costs money.
Uniform photos, ID cards and letterheads on WhatsApp are props. Verification means calling official numbers YOU look up.
Guaranteed returns, {0}% off canteen cars, lottery wins you never entered — pricing that beats the market exists to beat you.

When you paste a message into the message scanner, that text is checked entirely on your own device against a built-in list of fraud patterns. Google and Apple may provide us with anonymous, aggregated statistics such as total downloads. These are produced by the stores under their own privacy policies, not by the app, and contain no personal data.

The best protection for personal data is not to collect it, which is how Shield Force is built. What the app saves stays in its private storage on your device, protected by your phone's own security (screen lock and encryption). The website is served only over encrypted HTTPS.

We keep no data about you, so there is nothing to delete on our side and no account to close.
